summary: The same gap found in the balance lookup applies here, and matters more: this flow has an irreversible step. A rejected credential left the run hunting for controls that only a signed-on session shows, until it failed as target_not_found marked escalatable — so a wrong password would have summoned a person to a session that could never proceed, at the same desk that exists to approve account openings. SIGN_ON_FAILED now ends the run at the sign-on screen with an answer the caller can act on, and the irreversible step is never reached.

addOutcomes.description: The application rejected the supplied operator credentials. Retrying cannot help, and neither can a person taking over the session, because the credential the caller holds is the one that is wrong.
